title: Evidence Knowledge Graph and Hypothesis Engine
goal: Build a read-only assessment knowledge graph that links findings, artifacts, task outputs, inventory nodes, approvals, scope records, runner metadata, and rationale entries into evidence-backed hypotheses. The graph must help AI choose what to investigate next without hardcoded tool chains or unsupported claims.
scope: AI planning data layer and evidence graph construction.
generation_reason: AegisPT must become smarter than a fixed sequence of tools by reasoning from observed evidence, prerequisites, and hypotheses while staying evidence-first and safe.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: The graph is analysis-only and must not broaden targets, dispatch runners, alter approvals, or infer proof without stored evidence.

success_criteria: A graph builder produces stable nodes and edges for runs, tasks, findings, artifacts, inventory, approvals, scope, runner metadata, rationale entries, and report evidence.
A hypothesis service returns evidence-linked hypotheses with source IDs, confidence, missing prerequisites, and safe next-observation candidates.
Hypotheses never claim unobserved impact and clearly separate observed evidence from inferred next questions.

acceptance_criteria: A fixture run with multiple findings and task artifacts yields graph hypotheses with source IDs and missing-prerequisite explanations.
No runner dispatch, approval mutation, scope mutation, or runtime self-modification occurs.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Adding exploit payloads or bypassing approval gates
